disclaimers: Flat per-election figure covering Election Day service plus training; single published rate for Deputies and Inspectors
disclosure_of_risks: Minimum 14-hour workday; mandatory online plus hands-on training before each election required to be permitted to work
guarantees_or_promises: none - flat county poll worker per-election pay
objective_evidence: Supervisor of Elections published pay figure
party: Lee County, Florida, Supervisor of Elections (county)

standard.s3: Deputies and Inspectors are paid $200 per election for Election Day service and completing the required training classes. Positions: Precinct Deputy, Register Ballot Inspector, Voter Assistance Inspector. All poll workers set up and disassemble the polling room on Election Day.
standard.s4: Must be a registered voter in Lee County; English literacy; have an email address; lift 15-30 lbs; sit/stand for extended periods; dependable transportation; complete mandatory online training class AND attend hands-on training at the Elections Center before each election; nonpartisan on Election Day.
standard.s5: Official requirement: able to work a minimum of 14 hours.
standard.s6: Minimum 14 hours; estimated 14-15 hours including setup and closing.
